sources.title: GitHub - ket0x4/dave.ai: Overengineered telegram bot that functions as ...
sources.snippet: Ket.AI is an telegram bot that functions as a chatbot powered by an OpenAI compatible API (Thats mean you can use it with any server like llama.cpp). It is designed to provide a conversational interface for users, allowing them to interact with the bot in a natural language format.
